en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hasan Bin Ali, from Aban, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the one in Ihraam complains of his eyes, so let him apply Kohl wherein is neither musk nor perfume’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Aban from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one in the state of Ihram suffers from illness in the eyes it is permissible for one to use kohl which does not have musk or perfume in it.’”
